title: Use L'Hopital's rule
text: As $$k$$ approaches $$1$$ the fraction has the form $$\frac{0}{0}$$, so take the derivative of the top and bottom with respect to $$k$$.

title: Evaluate
text: The derivative of the top is $$t e^{k t}$$ and the derivative of the bottom is $$1$$. At $$k=1$$ this gives $$t e^t$$.
